tools.name: options_question
tools.description: Requires a SignalDock account connection. Expected move, near-money skew/activity or IV history for one equity or futures root. At most five provider operations. tools.name: trading_day

Requires portfolio consent and existing service access/API allowance. Does not save a portfolio, place orders or synchronize a broker. Saved option holdings can be read with read_portfo

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_report, trading_day, read_workspace · Private data: read_portfolio · Public sink: analyze_portfolio · Destructive: analyze_portfolio.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_report, trading_day, read_workspace · Private data: read_portfolio · Public sink: analyze_portfolio · Destructive: analyze_portfolio

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_report" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
